mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin ( username, password, role, store_id, is_active, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{storeId}, #{isActive}, #{mustChangePassword} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin WHERE is_active = 1 AND must_change_password = 1
SELECT a.id, a.username, s.name AS storeName, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin a JOIN store s ON a.store_id = s.id WHERE a.is_active = 1 AND a.must_change_password = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin SET password = #{password}, must_change_password = false WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(must_change_password = 1) AS tempCount, SUM(must_change_password = 0) AS normalCount FROM admin WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL
